text_block_list.text:
Heading toward the Takarazuka Kinen, the 
great spring showdown where powerhouse 
rivals clash.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well now, Mirako, Lord Dants. Have you 
steeled your resolve to run?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... Well... Since I have the chance, 
I thought maybe I'd give it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I plan to do the same. I don't think the 
chances of winning are... zero, after all.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, if your mind is made up, that is 
best of all!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The formations of both generals, Lord Kris 
S and Lord Tap— we shall shatter them in a 
single stroke!

The two reluctantly get to their feet. No 
Reason rejoices. However...

Dark clouds rolled in from an unexpected 
direction...

text_block_list.name: TV Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love-san, you've captured the 
Tiara Double Crown! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: TV Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Following the Oka Sho, she took a complete 
victory in the Yushun Himba as well! A 
massive crowd has gathered for the 
celebration party.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Following her Satsuki Sho victory, Neo 
Universe conquers the Tokyo Yushun 
(Japanese Derby)!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
With terrifying racing instincts, she has 
comfortably claimed the Double Crown!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Grmmm... Double Double Crowns, you 
say...!? Curse that Silent Clan!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
A truly unstoppable, roaring advance. That 
said, she's still in the Classic tier. We 
won't be standing on the same battlefield 
yet, but...
choice_data_list:
Still, it's terrifying to think of what 
she might become...

Still, it's terrifying to think of what 
she might become...

text_block_list.text:
"Six months from now... which means by the 
end of this year, there's a high chance 
we'll be facing them."

"The assumption that she would 'become a 
threat then'— was far too naive."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe will perform a――"swing-by." 
……Toward the "Takarazuka Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I want to "connect." With a "VULX" I 
haven't encountered yet.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
ââ!? Entering the Takarazuka Kinen... 
you say?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Just one month after the Japan Derby... 
She plans to launch an assault against 
higher-tier opponents!?

It's true that according to the rules, 
even a Classic-class runner can enter the 
Takarazuka Kinen. However...

Due to the difference in power compared to 
the Senior Class, runners usually don't 
enter. Let alone a Derby Umamusume—it was 
an unprecedented move.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Guh, or perhaps this is an even greater 
reckless act than Lord Gimlet's daring 
Mile Championship rotation...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
A member of the Clan of Silence, Lord 
Universe... Could he be an otherworldly 
general against whom no standard tactics 
apply?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Not good... not good... Not good, not 
good, not good...! I have to stop this 
somehow!

"This declaration to run by Neo Universe 
had a major impact..."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm? Isn't that over there... Mirako and 
Lady Dants. What are they talking 
about...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh boy...! To think that even 
Universe-chan would show up... Th-there's 
no way I can win this~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The competition was crazy strong to begin 
with. Maybe... maybe I shouldn't even be 
running in this...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! I don't want to give up before I 
even run, but... still—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"My opponent is a Double Crown 
Umamusume... You can't win just on the 
desire to win alone, can you...?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Right...? Hmm... Maybe we really should 
just wait and see—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
You plan to wait and see... and maneuver 
your way through this?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Are you trying to wait out the clash 
between fierce commanders just to secretly 
glean the leftovers?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: No Reason-senpai...! Were you listening?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I understand how you feel completely. 
However—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The Sengoku era isn't soft enough for you 
to conquer the realm solely by running 
away!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: No Reason-chan...

Within those eyes burned a fierce, untamed 
presence.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Retreating to win is fine! If it is for 
the sake of counterattacking later, that 
is. Howeverâ

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If you don't, you'll slowly be cornered. 
And what awaits at the end of that is—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Having lost both strength and courage, 
there's nothing left for me... but to 
perish.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If you think you can protect anything by 
constantly running away, you're dead 
wrong!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
There comes a "crucial moment" for all of 
us. If one were to run away from that 
deciding battle—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The day will never come when someone like 
that stands at the center of an era!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
In the jaws of death, there is life! Only 
upon those who believe in themselves— no, 
who push forward even when they cannot 
believe— will the heavens smile.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mirako! Dantsu! Wake up! The blaze is 
already licking at your heels!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Auu~, but...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The raging flames... are scorching my 
feet...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I... suppose so. I think... you're right.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Even if I run away here, there's no 
guarantee whatsoever that I'll win the 
next G1...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
When I decided to enter the Takarazuka 
Kinen before, my resolve was much 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I could do it! That's why I 
could run all the way there!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
This is the crucial moment. It's just as 
No Reason-senpai says.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Mirako-senpai, you should definitely run! 
In the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, we are not alone. Let's take 
on this challenge together."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu-chan... If even Dantsu-chan is 
going that far...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-chan, Tap-chan, Universe-chan... 
they're all intimidating. But...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, maybe I'll enter! If I do, a miracle 
might just happen.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Well resolved, both of you! Spoken 
like true generals of the Overthrow 
Alliance.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. A single arrow is easily broken, 
but three bound together shall not snap so 
easily. Ready?

Alone, it would be a tough situation. But 
with the three of us, the scope of our 
training expands immensely.

Let us challenge it with all our might. 
Into the dream battle, where all kinds of 
Umamusume clash together to contend for 
supremacy.
